thread:
nina: Quick sync (5m) to confirm owners for the postmortem alert-tuning action list. PM link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-2026-04-alert-churn

nina: Main goals: reduce noisy pages, verify thresholds won't hide real incidents, and finalize dedupe strategy.

harry: Can we see the current actions? I'll take responsibility for any infra-facing items.

maria: Copying actions from the PM: 
- T1: move svc-ingest from static rate -> percentile-based alert (owner: maria) — due 2026-05-06
- T2: implement dedupe by similarity-hash for spike alerts (owner: sam) — due 2026-04-29
- T3: add suppression + emergency override for daily-maintenance window (owner: oliver) — due 2026-05-08
- T4: deploy dynamic thresholding pilot for cache-thrash (owner: harry) — due 2026-05-14

sam: For T2, propose algorithm: 1) build fingerprint = sha1(service+error_type+bucket) 2) group by fingerprint 3) emit a single pager per fingerprint per 15m. Example: ```fingerprint: sha1("svc|err|bucket") dedupe_window: 15m```

oliver: Maintenance window: 03:00-04:30 UTC, allow manual override via tag `urgent=true`. Ops okayed this last week.

maria: Percentile alert: switch from >1% to p99 > 120ms sustained 5m. Need metrics team to expose p99 on svc-ingest. Blocker: metrics.kind currently only supports p95.
harry: I'll take metrics work, ETA 2026-04-28 for the p99 export.

sam: I'll sketch the PR for similarity-hash dedupe today and tag eng-oncall. Will include test vectors.

ops-bot: @harry p99 metric export job scheduled: 2026-04-28 01:00 UTC. Playbook updated: https://playbooks.redwood/runbooks/alert-tuning-2026

maria: Post-deploy verification plan: 1) 48h shadow run (alerts recorded but not paged), 2) manual audit of suppressed traces, 3) if silent failures found -> rollback. I'll own step 2.
harry: Dynamic threshold pilot: use seasonality model + 6h lookback, roll to 10% traffic for 72h. Rollback if false negatives > 2 in 24h.
oliver: I'll draft the suppression config with emergency override and add runbook entries for on-call.
sam: Dashboards needed: dedupe-hit-rate, suppressed-alerts-per-day, shadow-alerts vs real pages. I'll create dashboards and share links pre-rollout.
nina: Thanks. Owners = maria(T1), sam(T2), oliver(T3), harry(T4). I'll open tracker tickets and ping infra for any further blockers.
harry: One more thing — add a canary label to the p99 metric to avoid confusing alerts.
maria: Agreed. 
nina: Follow-up check-in Wednesday 16:00 UTC. Keep updates as short replies under the PM doc. :white_check_mark:
